description: What the thinking effort suite must notice: the setting stops reaching a protocol, a refusal of it is no longer repeated without it (or is taken from an error that is about something else, or is forgotten at once, or kept after a change of configuration), the decision offers a level the model or the protocol does not take, a task profile or the saved configuration loses it, or a heavy level leaves a Claude model no room to answer.

mutations.name: R1
mutations.what: Chat Completions and Messages requests no longer carry the setting

mutations.name: R2
mutations.what: Responses requests no longer carry the setting

mutations.name: R3
mutations.what: a Chat or Messages provider that refuses the setting ends the task instead of being asked once more without it

patches.old: if (reasoning && refusesReasoning({ status, data: parsed, info, sent: true })) {

mutations.name: R4
mutations.what: a Responses provider that refuses the setting ends the task instead of being asked once more without it

mutations.name: R5
mutations.what: a Claude model asked to think hard keeps the small output cap it was given

mutations.name: R6
mutations.what: a refusal that was confirmed is not remembered, so every later request is refused and repeated again

mutations.name: R7
mutations.what: any error that names the setting counts as its refusal, a rate limit or a server error included

mutations.name: R8
mutations.what: a level the catalog does not list for the model is sent anyway

patches.old: if (reasoning && reasoning.efforts.length > 0 && !reasoning.efforts.includes(effort)) return { send: null, why: 'value_not_offered' };

mutations.name: R10
mutations.what: OpenRouter gets reasoning_effort instead of its own reasoning.effort

mutations.name: R11
mutations.what: a task profile's setting does not reach the connection the task runs on

mutations.name: R12
mutations.what: choosing another provider keeps the level that was chosen for the first one

mutations.name: R13
mutations.what: the saved connection does not keep the setting

mutations.name: R15
mutations.what: saving the configuration again does not forget a remembered refusal

mutations.name: R16
mutations.what: a word that is not a level is accepted into the configuration

mutations.name: R17
mutations.what: a model profile does not give the setting to the task that uses it

mutations.name: R18
mutations.what: a model profile forgets the setting when it is saved
